Tie trial balance to subledgers, bank, payroll journal and intercompany

13-2011.00:21520.short: Build the monthly management pack from AFAS, explain variances and present it to management.

steps.what: Export trial balance and cost centre figures from AFAS into Excel
Map accounts to report lines and build pack tables and charts
Analyse variances against budget and prior year, write commentary

loop.input: Variances above threshold with the top journal lines and descriptions behind each
loop.output: One or two sentence draft explanation per variance, citing the journal lines used
loop.check: Every amount in the text must match a computed figure; every cited line must exist; unexplained variances flagged
loop.stop: One pass per variance, one retry on a failed check, else marked 'needs explanation' for the accountant
loop.why_not_simpler: Explanations come from free-text journal descriptions and invoice lines that rules cannot summarise

steps.what: Review pack with controller and present to management team

13-2011.00:21520.design: Replace the Excel pack with a scheduled Python job on the governed data platform that reads the AFAS extract, applies a versioned account mapping and builds the pack and a Power BI page each night after close. A bounded model step drafts variance commentary from journal lines with a tie-out check; the accountant edits and the controller approves before it goes to management.
13-2011.00:21520.previous_blocker: The account mapping and commentary lived in people's heads and Excel; building a pipeline for a 10-person finance team was not worth the developer time.
13-2011.00:21520.enabler_now: AI coding makes the mapping job and pack generator a few days of work, and models can draft commentary from journal text with numbers checked by code.
13-2011.00:21520.still_hard: Explaining why a variance happened often needs a call to a site manager; one-off events and accrual timing need judgement.
13-2011.00:21520.human_edge: Knowing which variance management will care about and saying what it means for the business, in the room.

13-2011.00:21520.altitude: The accountant stops building tables and spends the time on the three or four variances that matter; they own the account mapping and the materiality thresholds for commentary.

reach.learn: How actuals feed the rolling forecast so variance commentary and forecast drivers use the same lines.

evidence.claim: Accountants using AI closed 7.5 days faster across 79 firms
Models add unnoticed assumptions so workpapers cannot be rebuilt; numbers must be tied out by code
Generating report packs from a ledger extract is standard deterministic work

assumptions: The nightly AFAS extract used for Power BI includes journal line descriptions.
A budget per cost centre exists in AFAS or a maintained file.

Whether management wants per-site margin weekly.
Which data platform Noordhaven already governs.

13-2011.00:21522.short: Work out Noordhaven's corporate tax and VAT positions, depreciation differences and the tax provision each quarter and year-end.

steps.what: Export trial balance, fixed asset register and VAT ledgers from AFAS to Excel
Compute fiscal versus commercial depreciation, interest limits and fixed tax adjustments
Tag ledger lines as non-deductible or mixed costs (gemengde kosten)

loop.input: Ledger lines whose account and cost code rules do not settle deductibility, with description and supplier
loop.output: Tag (deductible, mixed, non-deductible) with a one-line reason
loop.check: Rules handle known accounts first; model tags only the rest; totals per tag reconcile to the ledger; every tag above EUR 2,500 goes to the accountant
loop.stop: One pass per line, no retries; low-confidence or unparsed lines go untagged to the review list
loop.why_not_simpler: Free-text booking descriptions (dinners, gifts, events) carry the meaning; account codes alone do not

steps.what: Judge uncertain positions, estimate Vpb provision and deferred tax
Write tax workpaper and hand to controller and external tax adviser

13-2011.00:21522.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform pulls the AFAS trial balance, asset register and VAT ledgers through the AFAS API, computes the fiscal adjustment schedule by fixed rules, and runs one bounded classification pass over unclear cost lines. It generates the tax workpaper in a fixed template on SharePoint; the accountant judges positions and signs, and AFAS Jonas is used for its checks when filing the returns.
13-2011.00:21522.previous_blocker: The fiscal rules lived in one person's Excel workbook, and booking descriptions were too free-form to classify by rules alone.
13-2011.00:21522.enabler_now: AI coding makes a tested rule engine over the AFAS API cheap to build, and a model can tag free-text cost lines with a reason that a person can check; AFAS Jonas already assists with corporate tax and VAT returns.
13-2011.00:21522.still_hard: Uncertain positions (innovation box, interest limits, intercompany pricing if any) need judgement and the tax adviser; nothing tests models on Dutch tax.
13-2011.00:21522.human_edge: Deciding which tax position the company takes and defending it to the tax adviser, the auditor and the Belastingdienst.

ambition.what: A tax provision updated each month-end instead of once a year, so the forecast includes a credible tax line.

13-2011.00:21522.altitude: The accountant stops rebuilding the workbook and spends the time on the three or four judgement calls; they own the fiscal rule set and sign off the provision before the controller sees it.

reach.learn: How the monthly provision and deferred tax move the forecast and cash tax timing.
Which cost codes make lines deductible or not, so coding at entry removes later tagging.

evidence.claim: AFAS Jonas assists with corporate tax returns from 2022 and VAT from 2026; the user stays responsible for the check.
Multi-step reasoning errors are over half of the top model's errors on accounting tasks; judgement is the bottleneck.
A bounded classification pass over booking descriptions is reliable enough when gated by thresholds and reconciled totals.

assumptions: Noordhaven files its own Vpb with an external tax adviser reviewing.
Fixed asset register is kept in AFAS, not a separate Excel.
unknowns: Whether there is a fiscal unity (fiscale eenheid) across the three sites' legal entities.
Which Profit version is in use and whether Jonas is licensed.
Whether the tax adviser accepts a generated workpaper format.
research_questions: How many ledger lines a year fall outside rule-based deductibility tagging, and how often would the model's tag change the provision materially?
Does the AFAS API expose fixed asset fiscal and commercial depreciation separately?
How far did last year's provision differ from the filed return, and why?

13-2011.00:21521.short: Design, build, change and document finance processes, AFAS setup, Excel tools and reports.

steps.what: Gather the need: new site, regulation, report request, process gap
Design the change in ledger, workflow or report
Build: configure AFAS, write Excel tools, Power BI and scripts
Test the change and write procedures in SharePoint

loop.input: Config export, job code and test results
loop.output: Procedure text and a test case list
loop.check: Code checks every config item and job step appears in the procedure; the accountant reads and edits
loop.stop: One draft per change; missing items listed for the accountant to write

13-2011.00:21521.enabler_now: AI coding lets an accountant build and test small jobs 10 or more times faster, and models draft procedure text from config.
13-2011.00:21521.still_hard: Design choices affect audit, tax and reporting. Code needs an owner, review and access control on the platform, and IT must govern it.
13-2011.00:21521.human_edge: Knowing how Noordhaven's warehouses, transport and agencies actually run, and turning that into a ledger and process the auditor accepts.

ambition.what: Readiness for Dutch B2B e-invoicing (1 July 2030) and KVK SBR filing of the annual accounts, which AFAS does not file [S8][S10]

13-2011.00:21521.altitude: The accountant becomes the builder of finance tools, not their user. They decide which tools move from Excel to governed jobs, and the controller approves.

reach.task: Maintain the AFAS extract and Power BI models
reach.learn: How the nightly extract is built and governed, so finance jobs reuse it instead of copying data

evidence.claim: B2B e-invoicing from 1 July 2030 and reporting from 1 July 2031 are planned but not yet law
A PDF is not an e-invoice; intra-EU and reverse-charge invoices are due within 10 days
Large companies file with KVK via SBR from FY2025 and AFAS cannot file this for them
AI coding speeds up building small data jobs

IT allows finance staff to own jobs under review
unknowns: Which Excel tools and macros the accountants rely on today
Whether Noordhaven counts as large for KVK SBR filing
Who in IT reviews and runs finance jobs

13-2011.00:21517.short: Keep the chart of accounts and coding rules in AFAS, code unclear entries, and fix miscodings.

steps.what: Add or change ledger accounts and cost centres for new needs
Maintain supplier default accounts, cost centres and VAT codes
Code invoices and entries the bookkeepers could not assign

loop.input: Invoice lines with supplier, description and amount, plus 24 months of coding history
loop.output: Ledger account, cost centre and VAT code with a reason
loop.check: Code checks the account and cost centre are active, the VAT code fits supplier country and reverse charge, and the choice matches history; mismatches go to the queue
loop.stop: One pass per line; anything below the confidence threshold or over EUR 10,000 goes to the accountant
loop.why_not_simpler: Unclear lines are the ones the supplier default rule already failed on; only the free-text description tells the cost type

steps.what: Find miscoded entries and book reclassifications

13-2011.00:21517.design: Configure AFAS supplier defaults as the first line of coding. A nightly Python job on the governed data platform runs outlier tests over every ledger line (account against supplier history, VAT code against country, cost centre against site). A bounded model step proposes codes for the lines the defaults miss. The accountant works one Power BI exception page and approves reclasses, which post to AFAS through the UpdateConnector.
13-2011.00:21517.previous_blocker: Coding checks were done by sampling at year end because testing every line in Excel was too slow. Free-text invoice lines could not be classified by rules.
13-2011.00:21517.enabler_now: Testing every transaction with plain code is cheap to build now. Models can classify short free-text lines against a known account list, with code checking the output.
13-2011.00:21517.still_hard: Chart of accounts changes affect reporting, Power BI and the audit, and stay a deliberate human decision. Reverse charge and intra-EU VAT coding need care.
13-2011.00:21517.human_edge: Deciding how the chart of accounts should reflect the business (sites, transport against warehousing) and when a new cost type deserves its own account.

ambition.what: A monthly miscoding sweep over every ledger line in place of a year-end sample, to cut audit adjustments

13-2011.00:21517.altitude: The accountant spends less time coding and more time owning the rule table and the exception page. They decide when a recurring exception becomes a supplier default.

reach.learn: Which suppliers and description patterns cause most unclear coding, so defaults are fixed at source

evidence.claim: Deterministic tests over every transaction suit internal control work at high autonomy
No benchmark covers Dutch VAT coding
Intra-EU and reverse-charge invoices carry specific timing rules under ViDA

assumptions: AFAS supplier defaults are only partly set up today
24 months of coding history is clean enough to learn from
unknowns: How many lines per month reach the accountant uncoded
Last year's audit adjustments caused by miscoding
Whether cost centres map one-to-one to the three sites
research_questions: What share of last quarter's lines would supplier defaults alone have coded right?
How many miscodings does an outlier test find in last year's ledger that the audit missed?
On 200 historical unclear lines, how often does the model's code match the final booked code?

13-2011.00:21511.short: Review AFAS, bank and agency-portal processes and recommend controls that keep financial data reliable.

steps.what: Pull AFAS user roles, authorisations and mutation logs
Test segregation of duties, IBAN changes, duplicate payments, interface breaks
Walk through processes with bookkeepers and payroll to see how work really runs
Write findings and control recommendations

loop.input: Exception list with counts and amounts, walkthrough notes, control catalogue
loop.output: Draft finding per exception: risk, cause, recommended control, owner
loop.check: Every figure in the draft is linked to the exception table; the accountant edits and approves each finding
loop.stop: One draft per finding, at most one redraft on request; otherwise the accountant writes it
loop.why_not_simpler: Turning notes and numbers into readable findings is writing; a template fills the numbers but not the cause and advice

steps.what: Agree actions with controller and chase follow-up

13-2011.00:21511.design: Nightly deterministic tests on the governed data platform run over every AFAS mutation, payment batch, CAMT.053 statement and agency invoice (segregation of duties, IBAN changes, duplicates, unmatched agency hours) and feed a Power BI exception dashboard. 13-2011.00:21511.previous_blocker: Testing was sample-based in Excel because writing and maintaining full-population tests across AFAS, Rabobank files and three agency portals cost more than the team had.
13-2011.00:21511.enabler_now: AI coding makes the test suite and connectors cheap to build and change; data already flows nightly to Power BI.
13-2011.00:21511.still_hard: Agency portals may lack APIs; deciding which exception is a real control weakness needs knowledge of how people work around the system.
13-2011.00:21511.human_edge: Seeing why people bypass a control and proposing one they will actually follow.

Which payroll mutations carry fraud risk and how to test them without reading personal data.

Leading models meet only 61.8% of criteria on full accounting tasks; judgement is the bottleneck.

Rabobank statements are available as CAMT.053.

What the external auditor currently tests and would rely on.

steps.what: Select sample of payments, agency invoices and payroll journals

Document findings, corrections and follow-up actions

How the G-account split and reverse-charge VAT are booked.

A model that adds an unnoticed assumption makes the workpaper impossible to rebuild.

Noordhaven uses a G-account for chain liability on agency invoices.

loop.output: rows with counterparty, amount, indexation, start, end, notice period, page reference

loop.output: first draft of the movements section, each claim linked to a figure
loop.check: every number in the draft is matched against the projection table by script; unmatched numbers block the draft
loop.stop: two drafts at most; otherwise the accountant writes from the tables
loop.why_not_simpler: a template can list numbers but cannot explain which movement matters and why in prose

Multi-step reasoning across files is the main failure mode, so each projection step is kept as checked code
Firms using AI closed books 7.5 days faster
Driver-based projection in Python on an AFAS extract is standard practice

Whether management actually uses the current analyses for decisions
Whether a governed data platform already exists or must be set up

reach.learn: How budget phasing is set, so variances from timing are filtered out before they are chased

Cost centre structure is stable within the year
Budget holders have Power BI access or can get it

How often the report goes out today and to whom

13-2011.00:21529.short: Assign, chase and check the bookkeepers' filing and recording work and send record packages to auditor and tax.

Chase missing invoices, receipts, approvals and agency hours
Check that every booking has its document and is filed correctly
Answer bookkeepers' questions on procedure and coding

Power BI already runs on a nightly AFAS extract at Noordhaven
Large companies file accounts with KVK via SBR, which AFAS cannot do for them, so packages to outside parties stay a separate step

Document attachments are visible in the AFAS extract
unknowns: Whether the OR sees the close tracker as a system that monitors staff performance (WOR art. 27)
Whether invoice documents are stored in AFAS or in SharePoint
Who approves invoices at each site today

Reconcile payroll journal to GL and wage tax payment
Check agencies' NEN 4400-1 status, G-account payments and hours against invoices
Review exceptions with Payroll and decide corrections or a supplementary return

Dutch WW premium differentiation and chain liability rules are rule-based and published

13-2011.00:21530.short: Test whether new or changed finance systems and interfaces will post and control correctly before go-live.

steps.what: Read the design, mapping and planned process changes

loop.input: design documents and field mappings
loop.output: list of affected accounts, VAT codes and controls, with page references
loop.check: each item cites a passage; the accountant confirms or deletes
loop.stop: one pass per document; unclear items go to the accountant
loop.why_not_simpler: design documents are free text with no fixed structure

steps.what: Write test cases with expected postings and controls
Run test transactions in the AFAS test environment
Compare actual postings to expected and log breaks
Write findings and the go or no-go advice

13-2011.00:21530.design: A reusable test harness in Python posts scripted test transactions through the AFAS Profit connectors into the test environment and compares results with expected postings, VAT codes and approval flows. A bounded model step turns design documents into a draft risk list; the accountant signs the go-live advice.
13-2011.00:21530.previous_blocker: Test runs were manual clicks in AFAS and comparison in Excel, too slow to repeat after each design change.
13-2011.00:21530.enabler_now: AI coding makes a scripted AFAS test harness quick to build and to extend per project.
13-2011.00:21530.still_hard: Spotting what the design leaves out, and getting a test environment with realistic data.
13-2011.00:21530.human_edge: Judging which control gaps matter for the audit and the close, and saying no to a go-live.

13-2011.00:21527.short: Advise the Finance Director and HR on the cost of pay, benefit, tax or system choices.

steps.what: Take the question and agree its scope with the requester
Pull payroll, headcount, flex and ledger data into Excel
Model scenarios such as CAO indexation, pension or flex mix
Write the advice memo with options and risks

loop.input: scenario model outputs and question scope
loop.output: draft memo with figures linked to model cells
loop.check: every number in the text is matched against the model; unmatched numbers block the draft
loop.stop: two drafts; then the accountant writes it
loop.why_not_simpler: the explanation of trade-offs is free text that a template cannot write

steps.what: Discuss the advice and answer follow-up questions

13-2011.00:21527.design: A scheduled extract on the governed data platform joins AFAS payroll, headcount and ledger data with agency hours into one cost baseline. A parameterised scenario workbook (CAO rise, pension premium, flex share) reads it, and a bounded model step drafts the memo with every figure tied back to the model.
13-2011.00:21527.previous_blocker: Each question needed a fresh hand-built extract from AFAS and agency portals, so there was no stable baseline to reuse.
13-2011.00:21527.enabler_now: AI coding makes a reusable extract and scenario model cheap to build; a model can draft the explanatory text once figures are fixed.
13-2011.00:21527.still_hard: Questions vary a lot, and long-range tax or pension advice depends on judgement and on rules that change.
13-2011.00:21527.human_edge: Knowing what the Finance Director and HR actually need to decide, and saying clearly where the numbers are uncertain.

ambition.what: Cost every CAO or flex-mix proposal before each OR or negotiation meeting, not only once a year.

13-2011.00:21527.altitude: Less time building spreadsheets, more time in the room where pay and staffing choices are made; the accountant owns the cost model used in those decisions.

Tax estimates belong on the mandatory human review list.

13-2011.00:21506.short: Report on asset use and audit results to management and recommend changes.

Reconcile assets to the ledger and calculate use per site
Gather open audit findings and their status
Write the report and recommendations

loop.input: utilisation figures, trends and findings status
loop.output: draft commentary per site and per finding
loop.check: tie-out of every figure in the text to the dashboard; flagged mismatches block release
loop.stop: two drafts; then manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: the commentary explaining causes is free text

steps.what: Present to the management team and agree actions

13-2011.00:21506.design: A nightly job joins the AFAS fixed asset register with ledger and fleet or forklift usage data and feeds a Power BI page on use, idle assets and book value per site. Audit findings move from a mail-and-Excel log into a SharePoint list with owners and due dates, and a bounded model step drafts the commentary with a tie-out gate.
13-2011.00:21506.previous_blocker: Usage data sits outside AFAS and had to be matched by hand to asset numbers each time.
13-2011.00:21506.enabler_now: AI coding makes the matching job and the Power BI page cheap; Power BI and SharePoint are already licensed.
13-2011.00:21506.still_hard: Usage data from fleet and warehouse equipment may lack asset numbers, so matching needs a mapping someone maintains.
13-2011.00:21506.human_edge: Recommending which assets to sell, move between Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo, or replace, and holding owners to audit actions.
